release_notes: Version 1.1.0: merge-free in-place downloads (no post-download merge, lower disk usage), a faster multi-connection engine (HTTP/2, adaptive connection allocation, connection rebalancing, 16 default connections per download), performance tuning for large torrents (disk cache, hashing threads, request queue, TCP preference), a per-video resolution picker and playlist downloads, browser-assisted capture for protected streams, and smoother completion notifications.
